    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0

    n = int(input[index])

    values = list(map(int, input[index:index + n]))
    index += n

    tree = defaultdict(list)
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        v = int(input[index]) - 1
        u = int(input[index + 1]) - 1
        index += 2
        tree[v].append(u)

    dfs(0, -1)

    results = []

            index += 1
            values[x] += val
            for child in tree[x]:
                values[child] -= val
        else:
            results.append(str(values[x]))

    print('\n'.join(results))
